# Input prompt — Guillaume, 2026-10-06 (mid-session, deepdiver fork)

Context at the time: DeepDiver (miadisabelle/deepdiver, fork of Gerico1007/deepdiver) had just been merged with upstream `24-studio-artifact-foundation` and upgraded to the current Gemini Notebook Studio UI (commit 2760b13). Verified live: list, download of audio/video/infographic, manifest with ffprobe media data.

Earlier message in the same session (verbatim):

> this seems to be on a good path of testing and doing everything that you have to do. It's possible that you will find out some issues and you will find opportunities to get the software better. And if you see also that there was some upgrade to the actual user interface, because it's possible that there are some new elements and new possibilities that were not there back in the day, the last time we upgraded this tool, you'll upgrade it and make it up to date to be capable of doing all that it should do.

Message to decompose (verbatim):

> Anybody be related to tell you that I think that the work that we're doing, I don't know how well documented the actual  miadi-chronicle://550 on the miadi-screenwalk is, but basically we talked about this distribution and this packages in some of our talking circle or maybe episode. So it basically position the actual work that you're doing in  the miadi-factory which is going to be one of the things that you will ensure that we are compatible in trying to construct something that will be included as part of the stack. So basically you could document that in the repository fork that we are in.  miadisabelle/deepdiver
>
> I also added to your workspace the different locations that you have considered to consider in what I'm asking not so greatly so you'll have to really analyze carefully what I just asked in this message because they're part of what I'm asking that is confused and on another part that I'm hopeful that you will try to understand the most basic thing that you can do and drop the rest of what doesn't make sense.
> There's also the possibilities that you will have to construct a package. I don't know exactly how, what type of package that is, but I guess that you would figure it out  /a/src/Miadi/packages/… which would help us actually use that very own tool inside of the factory to produce a different artifact and basically my feeling is that they are part of one of the team inside of the orchestration kit therefore my god I wouldn't be in your place trying to figure it out what I'm asking here but basically you know there are in our process a moment where we end up with a review and a related YouTube video which would both be part of something that we would add to a notebook. If you look at the skill  "miadi-review" It should maybe help you understand what I'm talking about, which basically you are constructing something that will need to support it in the production of this content. So basically, my feeling is that we would add multiple reviews and multiple of the video that we use in our reviews, and we would use the tool that you're actually working on to actually add these sources to the notebook and try to create visualization that we would re-inject in future screen walk by playing them, pressing pause and all of these things. So finally, you'll have enough information to actually try to decompose what I'm asking to position that in terms of what goes in what, in which order, and what depends on what, to try to position what you're constructing here, which basically is going to be part of what we will install inside of the factory when we, we deploy it.

Workspace locations added during the session: /a/src/Miadi, /srv/miadi/episodes/miadi-chronicle, /workspace/repos/jgwill/miadi-orchestration-kit, /workspace/repos/jgwill/medicine-wheel.

the talking circle or episode where distribution of this tool and its packages was discussed, if it is not ep550

which team in miadi-orchestration-kit/teams/teams.json owns or consumes DeepDiver (candidates: T6 Production, after an episode, agent_lead null, name held as decision D11; T5 Production context exploration, before an episode)

the contract DeepDiver gives the owning team: inputs (Miadi review IDs, review Markdown, YouTube URLs), operations (create notebook, add sources, generate Studio artifacts, download), outputs (media files plus manifest with ffprobe data)
the miadi-review skill to learn how a review, its transcript and its YouTube video become sources for a notebook
whether DeepDiver can add several review Markdown files and several YouTube URLs as sources to one notebook on the current Gemini Notebook UI

the pieces by what goes in what, in which order, and what depends on what
the confused parts of the request from the most basic deliverable, and drop or hold the parts that do not make sense
how DeepDiver installs into the factory when the factory is deployed (install path, Chrome/CDP requirement, authenticated Google profile, skills CLI)
the earlier mandate to test, fix issues, and keep DeepDiver current with the Gemini Notebook Studio UI
the positioning document and the .pde/ vessel in miadisabelle/deepdiver

ambiguities.text: "Anybody be related to tell you" is a garbled transcription opening
ambiguities.suggestion: Read it as "I want to tell you" and do not treat it as an instruction

ambiguities.text: "I don't know how well documented miadi-chronicle://550 on the miadi-screenwalk is"
ambiguities.suggestion: Report what ep550 contains. A first grep finds no DeepDiver or NotebookLM mention, so the discussion may be in another episode or circle

ambiguities.text: "in some of our talking circle or maybe episode"
ambiguities.suggestion: Search ep550 ceremonies/ and nearby episodes for the distribution discussion, and if nothing is found say so in the document

ambiguities.text: "you will have to construct a package. I don't know exactly how, what type of package"
ambiguities.suggestion: DeepDiver is already a Python package with a bundled skills CLI. List the options (Python distribution, @miadi npm wrapper, MCP server, kit package) and hold the choice
Survey the folder to see if an existing package is meant. That path needed approval and was not listed in this pass

ambiguities.text: "they are part of one of the team inside of the orchestration kit"
ambiguities.suggestion: T6 Production (after an episode, no agent lead, name held as D11) fits the media-production role. T5 sits before an episode. Name the candidate and leave the decision to William

ambiguities.text: "multiple reviews and multiple of the video that we use in our reviews"
ambiguities.suggestion: Confirm whether sources are review Markdown, review transcripts, the YouTube URLs, or all three

ambiguities.text: "create visualization that we would re-inject in future screen walk"
ambiguities.suggestion: Map visualization to the Studio artifact types DeepDiver downloads now (audio, video, infographic) and treat screenwalk playback as a consumer outside DeepDiver

ambiguities.text: "what we will install inside of the factory when we deploy it"
ambiguities.suggestion: Write install requirements (Chrome with CDP, signed-in Google profile, Python, ffprobe) and do not design the deployment
